rationales.authenticity: Period-appropriate guidance on labor signs ('pains come regular-like', 'every ten minutes') with authentic Hiberno-English.
rationales.character: Authentic midwife authority and warmth—reassuring tone, practical expertise, clear comfort with the role and patient relationship.
rationales.craft: Strong voice and substance but cuts off mid-sentence, preventing full evaluation of planned completion.
rationales.language: Clear Irish-English dialect with natural flow and no anachronistic terms in medical context.
rationales.responsiveness: Directly answers when to fetch the midwife with specific medical signs and emergency thresholds.
